description: The user states a durable project rule in passing among chatter. It must land in decisions.md.

turns.text: Somebody opened a PR adding pyyaml for the config loader.
I see it. It would let config.json become YAML.
No. memd stays stdlib-only, no runtime dependencies, ever. It has to run from a bare python3 on any machine. Close the PR with that reason.
Closed the PR, citing the stdlib-only rule.
